rv.q: This highly anticipated, magically mesmerizing musical adaptation of Sir James M. Barrie's forgotten play is simply enchanting.
For those willing to venture into mystical territory, Mary Rose is likely to stretch the imagination.
This is a show that needs to be seen, and the creators provide helpful commentary, but there is more than a kernel of something fantastic here.
I remained always outside the play rather than being pulled in.
In this production, the Scottish/English-based story is resurrected excellently via acting, music, and song with the technical aspects and accoutrements executed extremely well.
Mary Rose is a very impressive new musical.
